cut_bottom_5.why: General-cell methods; useful but less leverage than current simplicial gaps.

cut_bottom_5.name: Isogeometric analysis
cut_bottom_5.why: Spline geometry/high-order approximation; substantial new infrastructure.

cut_bottom_5.name: Fractional/nonlocal PDEs
cut_bottom_5.why: Important but algorithmically distant from the present local-PDE core.

cut_bottom_5.name: Nonlinear eigenproblems
cut_bottom_5.why: Useful but lower leverage than rigorous linear spectral closure.

cut_bottom_5.name: Quantum-PDE specialization
cut_bottom_5.why: Domain-specific specialization should follow general spectral/PDE closure.

nonclaims: Several tracks are exact/reference fixtures or theorem contracts, not full production solvers.
Global RT1 assembly is topology/moment-contract level; full sparse high-order flux reconstruction remains incomplete.
3D equilibrated flux guarantee uses a tetrahedral reference fixture, not an arbitrary-mesh production engine.
Maxwell, Stokes, DG, SUPG, elasticity, contact, Helmholtz, stochastic Galerkin, FEM-BEM, and ALE are foundations/fixtures.
No reviewed theorem is promoted to machine-formal status by this milestone.
